fields.statement: QA at 9c8d4bf with a scratch build in a fresh repo: in an open change set rhiza link store serves log (capability to capability) exits 2 with code usage and message link type "serves" does not go from capability to capability under --json, plain, --dry-run and --record, writing nothing; link fast verifies store gives intent to capability, link c1 exempts log gives constraint to capability, both exit 2; link store serves fast and link store exempts c1 --note x --decision d1 succeed; linking the change set serves store is refused (change set to capability) and serves fast succeeds; rhiza apply with an add decision plus one bad link exits 2 naming writes[1], the log entry count stays 9 and later-link is not added.

QA at 9c8d4bf with a scratch build in a fresh repo: in an open change set I wrote link store serves fast, then edited the log entry into a verifies link from intent fast to capability store; rhiza check exits 0, prints ok and warn in-flight change set <id>, op <id>, link <id>: link type "verifies" does not go from intent to capability, both while draft and after propose; after rhiza withdraw, check exits 0 with no in-flight line. In a second repo the same forged link warns in-flight once while accepted, and after rhiza land it becomes one fail link line with no in-flight warning.
